research_question: Does fixed K32 omit material robust 2-opt opportunities, and does the frozen non-oracle selector cover more gain than equal-slot controls?
run_order: instance ID ascending, then execution seeds in listed order; one sequential GPU workload

guidance.reason: Model(anneal) selected explicitly; CLI Mix is a separate method, not silently substituted

seed_contract: Reset Python/NumPy/Torch per execution; preserve upstream discarded constructor/explicit seed and active np.random.randint(0,2**63-1) native seed

execution_contract.trace_mode_condition: Parallel traced must exactly match fast path in regression before principal collection

primary_tour: source_route (actual next-iteration search source and neural incumbent features)
secondary_tour: best_route (global best); report separately, never substitute into primary gate
distance: Unrounded Euclidean on the exact float32 native coordinates; independent float64 edge/gain/length; float32 source formulas for native pruning
canonical_move: unordered distinct nonadjacent tour-edge pair (i,j), i<j, j>=i+2, excluding (0,N-1)
scan_semantics: All-node frozen-tour potential evaluation; literal float32 distance early-break prefixes in both orientations, not actual evolving SRR execution
checklist_semantics: Reconstruct initial raw-tour checklist from native perturbation trace, validate raw array exactly; actual dynamic evaluated/accepted fields remain unavailable without native hooks

random.seed: SeedSequence([20261103, instance_id, solver_seed, completed_iteration, tour_kind_index]) generates allocation_seed; per allocation PCG64 SeedSequence([allocation_seed,r])

aggregation.order: within seed mean over iterations 500 and 1000, then equal mean of two seeds
aggregation.G2: mean independently verified best membership-missed relative one-step gain >=1e-4; zero if no robust miss
aggregation.G3: ratio of aggregated incremental all-node scan/pruning-aware gain masses; NOT mean of per-snapshot ratios
aggregation.uncertainty: descriptive paired instance summaries; fixed-seed bootstrap 10000 instance resamples, seed 20261105, no move-level inference

gates.G0: all technical/source/baseline/gain/candidate/data/tour/metric validation passes; unresolved inconsistency blocks
gates.G4: complete within resource limits with timing/memory evidence
gates.rule: GO iff all G0-G4; valid contradicted condition NO-GO; invalid/incomplete INCONCLUSIVE; resource-prevented RESOURCE-INCONCLUSIVE; all non-GO stop before Stage B

resources.includes: dataset generation, all 16 trajectories, KNN audits, snapshot diagnostics, aggregation and gate; excludes initial environment/build and pilots
resources.snapshot_reduction: none after freeze; cap breach is RESOURCE-INCONCLUSIVE

exclusions: No exclusion or replacement of any principal instance, seed or snapshot. Retain failed runs; any missing required data means INCONCLUSIVE.
stage_b: No implementation before independently audited GO. Membership/one-step oracle results are not solver improvements.
